quranic_reminders.translation: Does he not know that Allah sees?
quranic_reminders.context: Allah is fully watchful over every second, every glance, and every click. Do not let the screen make you forget your Creator.

quranic_reminders.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
quranic_reminders.translation: Did you think that We created you without purpose, and that to Us you would not be returned?
quranic_reminders.context: You were created for greatness, purpose, and worship. Endless scrolling on entertainment is beneath the dignity of your soul.

quranic_reminders.arabic: وَالْعَصْرِ • إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ • إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
quranic_reminders.translation: By time, indeed, mankind is in loss, except for those who believe, do righteous deeds, and advise each other to truth and patience.
quranic_reminders.context: Time is the only capital you have in this Dunya. Wasting an hour is an irreversible bankruptcy.

quranic_reminders.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
quranic_reminders.translation: Not a word does a person utter without having a vigilant observer by them.
quranic_reminders.context: The angels record your keystrokes, your screen time, and your intentions. Choose what you want written on your record.

quranic_reminders.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ • وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
quranic_reminders.translation: And that each human will have nothing except what they strive for, and that their effort will be seen.
quranic_reminders.context: Success requires effort and patience. Mindless entertainment strives for nothing and builds nothing.

hadith_reminders.hadith: Take benefit of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your preoccupation, and your life before your death.
hadith_reminders.theme: The Irreplaceable Gift of Free Time and Youth

hadith_reminders.hadith: The feet of the son of Adam shall not move on the Day of Judgment until he is questioned about five matters: about his life and how he spent it, his youth and how he used it, his wealth and where he earned it and spent it, and what he did with what he knew.
There are two blessings which many people lose: health and free time.
Part of the perfection of a person's Islam is leaving that which does not concern him.

study_interventions.headline: Why are you here right now?
study_interventions.message: You opened your device with a mission to learn, study, and grow. This video was not part of that plan.
study_interventions.action: Close this distraction and return immediately to your goals.

study_interventions.headline: What will this video give you in 5 years?
study_interventions.message: Nothing. Not a degree, not a career, and not real mastery. Your studies and craft will.
study_interventions.action: Do not trade your future for 15 minutes of cheap dopamine.

study_interventions.headline: Discipline is your true freedom.
study_interventions.message: Discipline is choosing between what you want right now and what you want most.
study_interventions.action: Prove to yourself right now that you control your mind, not an algorithm.

study_interventions.headline: The discomfort of studying is temporary.
study_interventions.message: The regret of wasted hours and failed exams lasts for years. Endure the struggle today and taste the honor tomorrow.
study_interventions.action: Breathe, re-open your notes or code, and do 25 minutes of deep focus.

study_interventions.headline: You are better than endless scrolling.
study_interventions.message: Algorithms are designed by multi-billion dollar companies to steal your life and sell your attention. Don't be their product.
study_interventions.action: Reclaim your mind. Close this tab now.

universal_time_reminders.quote: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
universal_time_reminders.author: Seneca (Roman Stoic Philosopher, 49 AD)
universal_time_reminders.context: Time is your only non-renewable asset. You cannot purchase yesterday back, but you own this moment.

universal_time_reminders.quote: You could be good today. But instead you choose tomorrow.
universal_time_reminders.author: Marcus Aurelius (Roman Emperor & Stoic)
universal_time_reminders.context: Procrastination is merely trading your potential today for an illusion of tomorrow. What you do right now defines who you are.

universal_time_reminders.quote: Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not.
universal_time_reminders.author: Cal Newport
universal_time_reminders.context: The ability to perform deep work is becoming rare at the exact moment it is becoming most valuable. Protect your focus.

universal_time_reminders.quote: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
universal_time_reminders.author: James Clear
universal_time_reminders.context: Your daily screen habits compound either for your greatness or your distraction. Choose mastery over cheap dopamine.

universal_time_reminders.quote: Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.
universal_time_reminders.author: Viktor Frankl
universal_time_reminders.context: The screen offered a distraction. In this single second, you have the freedom to choose your life's higher purpose.

universal_time_reminders.quote: Time stays long enough for anyone who will use it.
universal_time_reminders.author: Leonardo da Vinci
universal_time_reminders.context: True craftsmanship requires unbroken attention. Guard your hours as fiercely as an artist guards their canvas.

universal_time_reminders.quote: How long are you going to wait before you demand the best for yourself?
universal_time_reminders.author: Epictetus
universal_time_reminders.context: No one can make you focus, and no one can save you from wasted hours except yourself. Demand greatness from today.

stoic_discipline_reminders.quote: At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself: 'I have to go to work — as a human being.'
stoic_discipline_reminders.author: Marcus Aurelius (Meditations)

stoic_discipline_reminders.quote: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality. End the mental negotiation and return to work.
stoic_discipline_reminders.author: Seneca (Letters from a Stoic)

stoic_discipline_reminders.quote: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
stoic_discipline_reminders.author: Epictetus (Discourses)

stoic_discipline_reminders.quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
stoic_discipline_reminders.author: Bruce Lee
